description:
-= Attic =-
You find yourself in an attic. A standard kind of place. You decide to just list off a complete list of everything you see in the room, because hey, why not?

You make out a locked locker.

There is an unblocked exit to the west.
inventory: You are carrying: a passkey and a paper towel.
objective: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First thing I need you to do is to make absolutely sure that the locker within the attic is unlocked. After you have unlocked the locker, make absolutely sure that the locker in the attic is opened. Got that? Good!
